label: build F2 1/4
result:
Unit 1 of 4 is done on branch `v2/f2`: head.js, the ui.js core, and `/api/shell` with the parts registry. There are 5 commits, nothing is pushed or merged, HEAD is detached so the branch is free, and the port 8012 server is stopped. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` prints "all good" with the new f2 check included. 13 pages load with no console errors or warnings, light and dark, at 1280 and 390. Two things are not verified: the prerender rules (whether a prerendered page really holds its writes until shown), and Q on the practice session, whose spec rules conflict (see below).

**Commits (oldest first)**
- `93d8a92` **`server/api_shell.py`:** `GET /api/shell` returns everything the chrome shows in one call: your name and avatar, streak, today's figures, the plan, Review counts, saved, words due, the daily challenge, the Resume item, the newest report, exam dates and registration, this device, and prefs.
  - Seven modules (plan, compete, reports, achievements, account, words, review) can each add their piece through `shell_part(learner, tz)`, and `next.queue` fills Up next. If one module fails, it is logged and skipped, and the rest of the reply still arrives.
  - A retired code or a dead device token gets `{retired: true}`. There are no class fields.
- `909432f` **`server/checks/f2.py`:** covers the reply's keys, one streak shared with `/api/me`, Resume, the plan's question count, retired codes, and a failing module being skipped.
- `fbe05b7` **`web/assets/head.js`:** applies theme, text size and motion before the first paint. Light is the default and sets nothing on the page.
  - F1's view-transition fix is in: 20 page changes, 7 of them interrupted, with fonts blocked, gave 0 errors.
  - It also adds the prerender-on-hover rules, which skip the session, test, sign-in, link, admin and api pages and `?next=` links.
- `5e94598` **ui.js core:**
  - `UI.learner` and `UI.useLearner`, including the shared-computer mode, where a new tab asks an open one for the sign-in and waits up to 300 ms.
  - `UI.api` sends X-Learner and X-Tz and picks up X-Learner-Swap. Writes wait while a page is prerendering. It shows the offline banner (retrying at 5, 10, 20, 30 s, cleared by any server reply) and the retired banner.
  - `UI.cached` and `UI.whenVisible`.
  - Shell data: `UI.refresh` (`UI.me(true)`) and `UI.onShell`, which set `UI.answered`.
  - `UI.prefs` and `UI.prefRow`. A row saves the moment it changes, says "Saved", and puts the control back if the save fails. It shows "Set by Build" or "Back to Build" for keys a mode or exam stage sets.
  - `UI.look` applies theme, text size and motion, following System, and stores only non-default values in `satf.look`.
  - `UI.keys`: key sequences such as "G T", scopes, the one-key-per-action checks (they throw on `/dev/` pages), the global keys of §2.8, and the `?` sheet.
  - The skip link, which is the first Tab stop.
- `fb3f147` **`UI.SAT_DATES`** is filled from the shell, so every exam-date picker lists the real upcoming dates.

**Spec calls I made**
- **No `assignments` key or role line (decision 5).** Shell acceptance item 7 still lists `assignments`; the check should be amended.
- **Theme follows the server.** On every fresh shell load, the server's prefs win over `satf.look`.
- **Q on the practice session.** product.md G2 says Q opens the quick sheet in the runner; R29 and Shell acceptance 12 say it doesn't. G2 wins by R39, so Q works wherever `quick.js` is loaded, except `/test/`. The session page's owner decides by loading it or not.

**Left for later units**
- **Unit 2:** replace the old top bar (`UI.shell`), which is kept for now and reads `/api/shell`. Sign out, NAV and SECTION are also there.
- **Unit 3:** the storage-blocked, first-visit and save-nudge banners, toasts, `quick.js`, `palette.js` (with the topic aliases beside TOPICS), and `qr.js`. The offline and retired banners are already done in unit 1. `Q`, `⌘K`/`/` and `[` switch on by themselves once `UI.quick`, `UI.palette` and `UI.shell.toggle` exist.
- **Unit 4:** extend `f2.py` to the full acceptance list.
- **Not assigned to any unit:** shell-me.md gives F2 `server/next.py` (Up next), `web/sw.js` and `UI.nowStrip`, but none of the 4 units covers them. `/api/shell.next` stays `[]` until `next.py` exists.

**Needed from other owners**
- **F1 (`kit.js`):** `UI.toast` and `UI.sheet` should wait for `UI.whenVisible`, so a prerendered page never shows a toast or sheet unseen (U23).
- **F4 (`prefs.py`):** mark which keys a mode bundle sets (for example `bundled: true`) in `GET /api/prefs`. ui.js has a stopgap copy of that list (flagged with a `ponytail:` comment) until then.
- **S1:** the device ping and leaving endpoints (`/api/devices/this/ping` and `/leaving`) that the shared-computer mode already calls. Also `/signin/`, which should call `UI.useLearner(token, {session: true})` for a shared computer.
- **S8:** `compete.closing_soon(learner, tz)`, and a challenge board that respects board visibility.
- **Pages:** `UI.plan.dayOf` is still used by 7 pages (R14 deletes it). The G keys go to pages that don't exist yet: `/review/`, `/words/`, `/compete/`, `/help/`, `/me/settings/`.

**Relayed question: "what should I tell my other guy"**
I only saw that line, not who the other person is. If they're working in this repo, the parts that matter to them are "Needed from other owners" and "Left for later units".
